sloka: स हि तिष्ठति धर्मात्मा मां प्रतीक्ष्य समुत्सुकः ।तत्र विघ्नं सुतस्येह कर्तुं नार्हसि मुञ्च माम् ।। ७.२६.३८ ॥
transliteration: sa hi tiṣṭhati dharmātmā māṁ pratīkṣya samutsukaḥ ।tatra vighnaṁ sutasyeha kartuṁ nārhasi muñca mām ।। 7.26.38 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, that righteous one waits for me, very eager; you ought not to create an obstacle for your son in this matter, so release me.
